breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth removes the incorrect instruction to replace the distributed weight with a single concentrated load. The Agent, however, kept this incorrect instruction: 'For the elongation calculation, replace the distributed self-weight with a single concentrated load equal to the total weight acting at the free end.' This directly contradicts the physics of the problem and fails to align with the ground truth's correction.
